project.description: Downloads one stack's bdc.env and the shared configuration.json into configs/, for editing and re-upload through Upload PIC-SURE-Frontend Configuration. bdc.env is per stack, so the choice matters; configuration.json is the same file for every stack.

hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.name: TARGET_STACK
hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.description: Which stack's bdc.env to act on. Based on selection we determine if is a or b stack. configuration.json is shared by both stacks and is not affected by this choice.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash
set -e # Source folder containing the scripts source_scripts_folder="${JENKINS_HOME}/workspace/Bash_Functions/" ls -la "$source_scripts_folder"
# Iterate through the files in the folder and source them for script_file in "$source_scripts_folder"*.sh; do chmod +x "$script_file" if [ -f "$script_file" ] && [ -x "$script_file" ]; then echo "sourcing $script_file" source "$script_file" fi done
: "${TARGET_STACK:?TARGET_STACK is required}" target_stack=$(get_stack "$TARGET_STACK") echo "Resolved TARGET_STACK ${TARGET_STACK} to stack ${target_stack}"
mkdir -p configs if aws s3 --sse=AES256 cp "s3://$stack_s3_bucket/configs/pic-sure-frontend/$target_stack/bdc.env" configs/bdc.env >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "Downloaded configs/pic-sure-frontend/$target_stack/bdc.env" elif aws s3 --sse=AES256 cp "s3://$stack_s3_bucket/configs/pic-sure-frontend/bdc.env" configs/bdc.env >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "WARNING: this stack has no per-stack bdc.env yet; downloaded the pre-migration configs/pic-sure-frontend/bdc.env instead." >&2 echo "WARNING: uploading it back through Upload PIC-SURE-Frontend Configuration with TARGET_STACK=$TARGET_STACK completes the migration for this stack." >&2 else echo "ERROR: no bdc.env found for stack $target_stack." >&2 echo "ERROR: looked for s3://$stack_s3_bucket/configs/pic-sure-frontend/$target_stack/bdc.env" >&2 echo "ERROR: and s3://$stack_s3_bucket/configs/pic-sure-frontend/bdc.env" >&2 echo "ERROR:" >&2 echo "ERROR: There is nothing to download. To create one:" >&2 echo "ERROR: 1. Run this job against a stack that does have a bdc.env, or copy .env.example" >&2 echo "ERROR: from the PIC-SURE-Frontend repository." >&2 echo "ERROR: 2. Set LOGGING_API_KEY to the value in this stack's rendered" >&2 echo "ERROR: configs/pic-sure-logging/$target_stack/logging.env." >&2 echo "ERROR: 3. Upload it with 'Upload PIC-SURE-Frontend Configuration', TARGET_STACK=$TARGET_STACK." >&2 exit 1 fi aws s3 --sse=AES256 cp "s3://$stack_s3_bucket/configs/pic-sure-frontend/configuration.json" configs/configuration.json
